title: settling-bound
description: An ordinal lambda that bounds the settling index of a family of predication valuations, so settling steps tau range over tau < lambda. It is produced as the codomain a settling supplies to fix how far the iteration may run.

ordinal.description: lambda, a fixed ordinal serving as the bound; typically omega for countable, finite-convergence settlings

bounds-settling-index.description: every settling step tau satisfies tau < lambda

fixed.description: lambda is a single fixed ordinal, not the class of all ordinals, avoiding size-theoretic issues while retaining transfinite flexibility
